clauses.description: Discrete individually-assessable policy sections/clauses. Same shape as Regul.ai EXTRACTION_TOOL_SCHEMA (record_clauses). Segment internal policy manuals into sections a compliance officer can map on their own. Preserve official headings exactly as printed (e.g. 1. Introduction, 7.4, 8. Independent Reviews, 9.4.1). Do not invent sequential ids such as 1-14 or 1.-15. Go to the DEEPEST enumeration level: if section 2.3 has sub-points (a)(b)(i), emit 2.3-a, 2.3-b — never one merged 2.3 summary. Letter suffixes only for official lettered/unnumbered sub-points under a real heading. Full verbatim clause_text — do not summarize obligation body text. Skip preambles, revision history, table of contents, and admin-only text unless they impose an obligation. EXCEPTION: entire annexes/typology/red-flag illustrative lists are ONE clause per annex group (summarize the group; do not split every example). Every clause_no must be unique.

clause_no.description: Official printed heading number, e.g. 7.4 or 1. Introduction or 2.3-a. Never invent 1-14 style counters.

clause_text.description: Full text of this individually-assessable section — verbatim for obligations, not summarized

source_page.description: 1-indexed PDF viewer page where this section starts; use 0 if unknown
